import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx', sheet_name='Transactions')
# Ensure Amount is numeric
df['Amount (INR)'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
total = df.query("`Funding source` == 'USAID sub-grant'")['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print(total)
# also sum of all funding sources for sanity
print(df.groupby('Funding source')['Amount (INR)'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False))
